audited_source_corrections.action: Restored prefix sigma on the true-conjunction premise in the complete-branch example.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The conclusions both carry sigma and the definition concerns prefixed formulas, but the conjunction premise alone has no prefix.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் மெய்யான இணைப்பின் எடுகோளில்~$[\sigma]$ முன்னொட்டை மீட்டுள்ளது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Removing prefixes from both conclusions; retaining an unprefixed premise in a prefixed tableau.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: A propositional tableau rule preserves the same world prefix from premise to conclusions.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Do the conjunction premise and both conclusions now share prefix sigma?

audited_source_corrections.action: Changed the left alternative generated from a true disjunction from false B to true B.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The true-disjunction branching rule displayed earlier yields T B or T C, but this completeness example says F B or T C.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் மெய்யான பிரிப்பின் இரு மாற்றுகளையும் மெய்க்குறியுடனே தருகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Changing the premise to a false disjunction; retaining a branch that does not satisfy the premise.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: Truth of B or C is preserved by choosing a branch where B is true or C is true.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Are both alternatives in the true-disjunction example true-signed?

audited_source_corrections.action: Supplied operand B in all four modal premises and changed all four modal conclusions to the unmodalized B required by the rules.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The examples write bare Box or Diamond with no operand and then repeat that operator in the conclusion, whereas every rule earlier takes Box B or Diamond B to the unmodalized B at a successor prefix.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் நான்கு எடுகோள்களிலும்~$!B$ ஐச் சேர்த்து, முடிவுரைகளில் செய்கையை நீக்குகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Treating Box and Diamond as complete formulas; repeating modal operators contrary to the displayed rules.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The completeness conditions must instantiate exactly the new-prefix and used-prefix rules whose truth lemma follows.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Do all four modal examples now use Box B or Diamond B as premise and B as conclusion?

audited_source_corrections.action: Changed the construction's final claim from every branch being closed to every branch being complete.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The proposition constructs a tableau whose branches satisfy all four completeness conditions; it cannot guarantee closure, and the following theorem specifically needs an open complete branch.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் கட்டமைப்பின்படி ஒவ்வொரு கிளையும் முழுமையானது என்று முடிக்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Claiming every finite set has a closed tableau; changing the proposition and following completeness proof.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: Systematic exhaustive rule application yields complete branches, some of which remain open exactly when the initial set is satisfiable.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the proposition proof conclude branch completeness rather than closure?

audited_source_corrections.action: Changed the second induction alternative from falsity of B to falsity of C.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The branch alternatives are F B and F C, but the semantic conclusion repeats F B twice.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் இரண்டாம் மாற்றில்~$!C$ பொய் எனக் கூறுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Changing the branch rule to duplicate B.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: A conjunction is false when B is false or C is false.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the false-conjunction induction step mention B and C exactly once?

audited_source_corrections.action: Changed the second induction conjunct from falsity of B to falsity of C.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The complete branch contains F B and F C, but the semantic conclusion repeats F B twice.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் இரண்டாம் இணைப்பில்~$!C$ பொய் எனக் கூறுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Changing the branch rule to duplicate B.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: A disjunction is false when both B and C are false.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the false-disjunction induction step mention B and C exactly once?

audited_source_corrections.action: Changed the second induction conjunct from falsity of B to falsity of consequent C.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The complete branch contains T B and F C, but the semantic conclusion says T B and F B.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் பொய்யான உட்கிடையின் விளைவுறுப்பு~$!C$ பொய் எனக் கூறுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Changing the branch rule or conditional formula to make B both true and false.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: A conditional B implies C is false exactly when B is true and C is false.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the false-conditional induction step conclude truth of B and falsity of C?
